observation.visible_scene: A large, blackened tree stump stands in a grassy field. An Amazon cardboard box sits at the base of the stump, engulfed in flames, with a pile of burning debris and flattened cardboard to its right. Another piece of flattened cardboard lies in the foreground. A line of trees is visible in the background.
visible_changes: The fire burns continuously, with orange and yellow flames rising from the box and the debris pile.
The flames flicker and change shape, reaching higher up the side of the tree stump over time.
The cardboard box remains in position but is actively consumed by the fire.
Faint smoke becomes visible rising above the stump in the later frames.
The background trees and the foreground cardboard remain static.
outside_clip_unknowns: The final state of the box after the clip ends.
